title: UnexpectedLengthException thrown frmo DefaultHttpDataSource.read
body:
Hi, 

On samsung GT-I8190 with 4.1.2 none of the HLS video  play, which do work on other devices (tested on Nexus 5 / 7 /9, Philips android TV, Lenovo A7)

HLS is AES encrypted. Looking at the log file It seems that It has to do something with the key (length) ? 

In the logs I get:
